title: add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Added RAG/agent quickstarts and example integrations. No breaking changes to public APIs. New docs pages and example projects to help customers onboard RAG and tool-calling agents.
description: This PR adds a set of developer-facing quickstarts and examples for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) templates and agent/tool-calling workflows, plus corresponding docs site updates and a small, backwards-compatible tweak to the agent SDK to support a standardized tool metadata schema. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG patterns and tool-using agents with production-friendly examples and step-by-step documentation. Contents: 1) examples/rag-templates/ - three runnable RAG templates (vectorstore + prompt templates + evaluation harness) with readme and test prompts; 2) examples/agents/tool-calling/ - a minimal agent that demonstrates function/tool calling with error handling, async streaming, and mocked external tool adapters; 3) docs/site/quickstarts/rag.md and docs/site/quickstarts/agents.md - new quickstart pages with code snippets, architecture diagrams (SVG), and troubleshooting tips; 4) docs/site/sidebar.yml updated to include quickstarts and examples; 5) redwood-sdk-python: minor agent SDK helpers (ToolMetadata type and validation util) to standardize tool descriptors used in examples; 6) lightweight tests and CI docs checks added to ensure quickstarts build and examples run in CI. Backwards compatibility: SDK change adds a new helper function and a permissive validator; no existing public function signatures were removed. Related: ENG-1023 implements the onboarding flow tracked in Linear. Checklist: - [x] Add example projects and READMEs - [x] Add docs pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add SDK helper and unit tests - [x] Update CI to run quickstart smoke tests - [x] Obtain reviews and address comments
